description: Parse pasted travel confirmation text into proposed itinerary segments without saving anything. Use this before creating segments from copied email, PDF, or booking text.

max_segments.description: Maximum number of segment previews to return, from 1 to 20. Defaults to 10.

text.description: Travel confirmation, booking, or itinerary text to parse: one booking confirmation per call, or a few days of an itinerary. A whole trip page listing many bookings can exceed the 90-second parse limit, so split it. Raw text is used only for parsing and is not echoed back.

trip_id.description: Optional trip ID used only to verify access and give the parser trip context

user_hint.description: Optional user-provided context, such as provider name or expected segment type

name: import_parse_text_preview
title: Preview Travel Text Import
